messages:
maria: @eli FYI customer ACME (acct acme-inc) reports objects with 30d TTL still returning 200 after expected deletion. Legal wants an immediate preservation window. They included a sample object id and screenshot. :rotating_light:
eli: can you paste the object id + a curl repro? also any API error codes the customer saw?
maria: sample id: obj_9b8c7d. customer ran: ```curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/obj_9b8c7d\"``` returns 200 and body. They say audit log shows a delete event at 2026-02-28T22:10:12Z.
sam: odd. deletion worker logged a 202 accepted and tombstone created on our side, but indexer shows a lag for that tenant. filing quick check on deletion-queue backlog.
kevin-oncall: @sam can you run `SELECT count(*) FROM deletion_queue WHERE tenant='acme-inc' AND state!='processed';` and check the oldest_enqueued_time?
sam: running, give me 2m.
support-bot: Ticket #248912 opened with ACME legal request; escalation level: high.
(1m pass)
sam: result: 4k entries for acme-inc still pending, oldest_enqueued_time=2026-03-01T01:05:00Z. indexer errors show repeated `502` from search-reindexer pod around that period. attaching snippet.
audit-bot: audit log extract for obj_9b8c7d:
```
2026-02-28T22:10:12Z DELETE user=svc-delete-worker obj=obj_9b8c7d request_id=req-0a1b2c status=202
2026-02-28T22:10:12Z KMS_HANDLE_ENCRYPT key=kms-prod-3 action=decrypt status=OK
2026-02-28T22:10:15Z INDEXER_MARK tombstone=obj_9b8c7d index_job=idx-345 status=queued
```
legal-team: we need a full audit export (delete api logs, indexer events, KMS access logs) for the preservation window and an expected deletion timeline for each object. provide HSM/KMS access baton if available.
maria: customer also flagged billing: they got a big purge-related invoice line and want to pause any additional charges until resolved.
eli: immediate steps: 1) mark account acme-inc as preserve-mode (no further deletions), 2) export audit logs (delete + indexer + kms) for 28Feb-03Mar, 3) re-run indexer replay for tenant in a read-only dry-run to validate tombstones.
kevin-oncall: I can apply preserve-mode flag. doing now. :thumbsup:
sam: starting indexer replay for acme-inc with `--preserve-only` to avoid accidental purges. command: ```kubectl exec -it indexer-ctrl -- /app/indexer replay --tenant acme-inc --mode preserve-only``` ETA ~12m.
audit-bot: KMS access log export: https://internal-logs.redwood/exports/exp-20263123 (s3 link, restricted)
eli: for billing hold, connect finance: @maria please create finance escalation and request temporary invoice hold referencing ticket #248912.
maria: done. created finance-escalate-248912 and pinged billing.
(12m pass)
sam: replay finished. found 3 objects where tombstone never reached storage due to indexer 502 loop; replay enqueued tombstones and queued reindex job.
kevin-oncall: reindexer pod patched with backoff fix and restarted; monitoring shows queue draining.
legal-team: please attach the audit export + replay logs to the legal packet. we need signed confirmation once objects are preserved.
maria: sent export to legal and to customer, asked them to confirm preservation.
support-bot: Update on ticket #248912: preserve-mode applied, audit export delivered, indexer replay completed, billing hold requested.
eli: follow-ups: add a postmortem for indexer 502 backoff, add a metric alert to catch deletion_queue > 1k for >1h for tenant-scoped queues.
maria: customer confirmed they see objects tombstoned and preservation is accepted. closing escalation after legal sign-off. :white_check_mark:
